market.question: Will the minimum Arctic sea ice extent this summer be less than 4m square kilometers?

assessment.reasoning: Arctic sea ice extent at or near record low for mid-April 2026 (second-lowest in NSIDC), with Super El Niño influence expected to accelerate melt. Recent minima 2023: 4.23M, 2024: 4.28M — close to but above 4M. Concerning early-season conditions raise probability of <4M, but historically only 2012 (3.39M) and 2020 hit such low levels.
assessment.key_uncertainty: How weather patterns evolve over June-September; preconditioning vs. summer weather
